thread:
tom (Partnerships): SylphAI emailed — they want to surface a 'compliance-checked' badge for their open quantized family and allow CloudWeave to include the model in a paid SI appliance. Primary asks: marketplace escrow for payouts until compliance attestation, inference watermarking opt-in, and different pricing for private deployments vs hosted.
rachel (Legal): escrow + attestation is doable but we need clear triggers for release. propose: marketplace escrow holds funds T+30 until SylphAI posts compliance report and we verify. also require a limited non-sublicense clause and an audit right for provenance.
devin (FinOps): escrow flow: AWS/GCP marketplace payouts typically take ~45 days. If we layer escrow we need to reconcile timings and fees. Will model cashflow: gross marketplace payout -> Redwood escrow -> release net to provider after verification - marketplace fees and withholding deducted. That adds processing overhead.
lucas (PM): product implications: if CloudWeave bundles downloadable appliance, we must show a Catalog badge `compliance-checked:v1` and an entitlement flag `si_appliance_allowed`. Also need runtime signal if inference-time watermarking is enabled to route to watermark-capable backends.
cloudweave-sales: CloudWeave wants a 30-day exclusive sell window for their appliance in EMEA. It's marketing+sales coordination, not distribution lock. They also need an SLA add-on for on-prem installs.
ops-bot: infra note -> add flags: `compliance_badge`, `si_appliance_allowed`, `watermark_supported`. Create ticket RD-OPS-9401.
maren (Marketing): 30-day exclusivity in region ok if SylphAI funds joint events. Need press/asset checklist and a line in the console banner about the compliance badge. Draft PR 7 days before go-live.	om (Partnerships): Proposed commercial split: Hosted API = 68/32, Marketplace appliance sales = 84/16 (marketplaces take a larger cut), SI appliance fee to CloudWeave = 10% of provider net. Escrow fee to be negotiated (marketplace may charge). Thoughts?
rachel (Legal): Approve commercial structure in principle. Draft addendum: (1) escrow release criteria (signed compliance report + Redwood verification), (2) watermark opt-in language and IP attribution, (3) explicit export control and sanctions warranty, (4) no sublicensing without provider consent for raw weights.
devin (FinOps): I'll run the net settlement scenarios including escrow holding costs and tax withholding for EMEA. Also raise whether provider prefers monthly vs immediate settlements post-release.
lucas (PM): RD-OPS-9401 created to add catalog flags and runtime watermark routing. ETA 10 business days for backend; UI flag to surface badge may take 2 weeks including marketing copy.
cloudweave-sales: we'll backfill co-marketing if SylphAI signs. We need technical notes for the appliance (installation, license check) by T-10.
tom (Partnerships): action list: 1) Rachel to send revised addendum template to SylphAI with escrow and watermark clauses; 2) Devin to model cashflows and escrow fees; 3) Lucas/ops to implement RD-OPS-9401 flags; 4) Maren to draft co-marketing checklist and console banner copy. Please update by EOD Wednesday. :+1:
